state.seed_assertion: Systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects based on automated processing, including profiling, on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person, is one type of processing that always requires a DPIA.

sentences.1: Systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects based on automated processing, including profiling, on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person, is one type of processing that always requires a DPIA.
sentences.10: A DPIA is required at least in the following cases: a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling
sentences.11: A data protection impact assessment is required for systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.
sentences.12: a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person
sentences.13: for example, a processing operation could evolve so that decisions are no longer automated or if a monitoring activity is no longer systematic, and the review of the risk analysis made can show that the performance of a DPIA is no longer required.
sentences.14: For example, a processing operation could evolve so that decisions are no longer automated or if a monitoring activity is no longer systematic.
sentences.2: Article 35(3) sets out three types of processing which always require a DPIA: Systematic and extensive profiling with significant effects: "(a) any systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person."
sentences.3: A DPIA is required in the case of a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.
sentences.4: a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person
sentences.5: A DPIA is required where an organisation uses systematic and extensive profiling with significant effects.
sentences.6: In particular, a DPIA is required where an organisation: uses systematic and extensive profiling with significant effects;
sentences.7: or processes special category or criminal offence data on a large scale;
sentences.8: or systematically monitors publicly accessible places on a large scale.
sentences.9: A DPIA is required for a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling.
